resources.string:
Dot Island uses Accessibility access solely to display the floating Dynamic Island overlay above the status bar and allow touch interaction directly around the camera punch-hole.

Dot Island operates under a strict Zero-Data Privacy Contract:
• It CANNOT read screen text, passwords, or personal messages.
• It CANNOT perform touches or gestures on your behalf.
• It CANNOT log keystrokes or track your usage.
• Zero accessibility data is collected, stored, or transmitted.
Enables touch interaction around the camera punch-hole.
Allows Dot Island to display incoming alerts and media metadata around the camera punch-hole.
